objective: Milestone 10: Outbound Delivery Intent Queue, Email Change Verification and Extraction Dispatching

tasks.description: Implement outbound delivery intent queue to manage the lifecycle of outbound notification requests (PENDING, DISPATCHING, DELIVERED, FAILED, SUPPRESSED, DEAD_LETTER), enforcing exponential retry backoff, channel failure isolation, and deduplication keys.
acceptance_criteria: enqueueDeliveryIntent(input, options) enqueues validated notification intents (email or telegram) with user ID, channel, template type, recipient address/chat, encrypted payload reference, and idempotent deduplication key
leaseNextDeliveryIntents(options) acquires leases on pending or retry-eligible intents with bounded TTL (e.g. 60s) to support safe concurrent worker processing without double dispatch

Supports status transitions: markDelivered(intentId, receipt), markFailed(intentId, error, options) with exponential retry backoff, markSuppressed(intentId, reason), and transitions to DEAD_LETTER once max retry ceiling (default 5 attempts) is exhausted
Provides circuit breaking and channel pause checks (isChannelPaused(channel)) when consecutive channel-level failures exceed error thresholds
Deterministic in-memory / SQL-compatible state transitions with comprehensive input validation and safe error handling
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/delivery-intent.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement verified account email change service to coordinate secure address updating, generating signed/hashed confirmation tokens, validating expiration windows, preventing email collisions, and managing audit logs.
acceptance_criteria: requestEmailChange(actor, newEmail, options) validates new email format, checks against reserved/existing user emails, and creates a pending email change request with a cryptographic verification token and bounded TTL (e.g. 1 hour)

verifyEmailChange(token, options) validates token authenticity, expiration, and user state, updates the account's primary email address atomically, and invalidates any other active pending change tokens for that user
cancelEmailChange(actor, options) allows the user to cancel any active pending email change request
Enforces rate limiting on email change requests (max 3 requests per 24 hours per account) and emits audit events recording requested and completed transitions
Pure domain logic and safe error handling (rejects duplicate emails, expired tokens, tampered tokens, and malformed inputs)
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/email-change.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement automatic extraction dispatch coordinator to evaluate harvested source snapshots, check operational spending caps and rate quotas, validate opportunity candidate schema compliance, and prevent duplicate extraction runs.
acceptance_criteria: evaluateExtractionEligibility(snapshot, options) checks whether a newly harvested source snapshot requires extraction based on content hash differences, existing extraction status, and source staleness
Enforces operational spending guards: checks against current spending meter status (refuses dispatch if budget ceiling reached or throttled) and reserves estimated microdollar costs
Coordinates extraction lifecycle states: PENDING_EXTRACTION, EXTRACTING, COMPLETED, SKIPPED_UNCHANGED, REJECTED_SCHEMA, FAILED
Deduplicates extracted candidates across snapshots and produces structured extraction summary records with field counts and confidence metrics
Handles malformed snapshots, empty content, schema mismatches, and budget exhaustion safely without unhandled rejections
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/extraction-dispatcher.test.ts && npm run typecheck
